title: Construct lossless candidates from explicit record edits
description: Actors can supply a bounded meaningful edit or batch and see exactly its intended candidate effects without hidden semantic changes. This logical behavior has the scope and limits of SR-043; retained v3 realization facets require reconciliation before replacement-store adoption.
inputs: Explicit supported operation, selected project/Change and expected coherent state.
Actor-supplied candidate or verified recovery basis, with declared subject and artifact identities.
outputs: Exact attributable result or explicit conflict, unavailability, rejection or recovery-required outcome.
behavior: The actor supplies required semantic inputs; the tool constructs identities and storage bookkeeping without requiring directories, manifests or database fields from callers.

Only explicitly selected semantic values and necessary mechanical metadata change. Omitted fields, ordered entries, narrative content, original subject identities and unrelated records remain equal; exact retained evidence payloads keep their content identity. Physical database bytes are not a semantic preservation oracle.

A bounded ordered batch constructs one final candidate; valid references to newly introduced entries resolve there. Duplicate or overlapping semantic assignments reject even if equal, while explicitly separate assessment/finding and decision/body spans retain their declared composition rules.

A new or corrected assessment preserves prior judgments and complete finding history. Under an immutable-attempt contract, corrected explanation or verification content is a new explicitly linked successor with its own supplied fields; omission does not erase the predecessor or silently change its applicability, actors, subjects or judgment. Narrow current-account updates cannot rewrite assessment cores.

Preview validates the same intended semantic candidate without authoritative writes, persistent reservations or a saved claim. Execution checks freshness again and does not treat preview as authority.

Unavailable known records or occupied destinations cannot be treated as empty creation targets. Explicit restoration remains subject to its own supported operation and normal integrity, authority and conflict checks.

failure_behavior.condition: The requested candidate, expected state or recovery basis cannot be established safely.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the corresponding bounded rejection, conflict or recovery condition without invented decisions, silent merge or unrelated overwrite.
